description: Overbought-pullback scenario: 14 consecutive gains drive RSI to 100 (overbought), then 5 declining candles demonstrate pullback. First RSI = 100 (pure-gain seed, avgLoss=0). After decline candles RSI falls below 70, confirming the primitive captures a realistic overbought-then-pullback pattern. All values in [0,100].

expectedOutput.note: First value MUST be exactly 100 (pure-gain seed, avgLoss=0). Values after index 0 reflect Wilder smoothing as losses appear.
